name: complex_GD_error_identity
stmt:
theorem complex_GD_error_identity (A : E →L[ℂ] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x : E) :
    A (GDUpdate (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x) - b =
      ((1 : F →L[ℂ] F) - (2 * η : ℂ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) (A x - b)
proof: GD_error_identity (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x

name: complex_GD_contraction_step
stmt:
theorem complex_GD_contraction_step (A : E →L[ℂ] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hspec : ‖(1 : F →L[ℂ] F) - (2 * η : ℂ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖A (GDUpdate (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x) - b‖ ≤ c * ‖A x - b‖
proof: GD_contraction_step (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x c hspec

name: complex_GD_sq_contraction_step
stmt:
theorem complex_GD_sq_contraction_step (A : E →L[ℂ] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hspec : ‖(1 : F →L[ℂ] F) - (2 * η : ℂ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖A (GDUpdate (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x) - b‖ ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2 * ‖A x - b‖ ^ 2
proof: GD_sq_contraction_step (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x c hc0 hspec

name: complex_GD_converges
stmt:
theorem complex_GD_converges (A : E →L[ℂ] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x0 : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hspec : ∀ x : E, ‖(1 : F →L[ℂ] F) - (2 * η : ℂ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, GDError (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x0 n < ε
proof: GD_converges (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x0 c hc0 hc1 hspec

name: complex_GD_iterate_contraction
stmt:
theorem complex_GD_iterate_contraction (A : E →L[ℂ] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (x0 : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hspec : ∀ x : E, ‖(1 : F →L[ℂ] F) - (2 * η : ℂ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, GDError (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x0 (n + 1) ≤ c ^ 2 * GDError (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x0 n
proof: GD_iterate_contraction (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x0 c hc0 hspec

name: complex_euclid_GD_converges
stmt:
theorem complex_euclid_GD_converges (d : ℕ)
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d))
    (b x0 : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d)) (η c : ℝ)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hspec : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d),
      ‖(1 : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d)) -
        (2 * η : ℂ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, GDError (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x0 n < ε
proof: complex_GD_converges A b η x0 c hc0 hc1 hspec

name: complex_euclid_GD_error_identity
stmt:
theorem complex_euclid_GD_error_identity (d : ℕ)
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d))
    (b x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d)) (η : ℝ) :
    A (GDUpdate (𝕜 := ℂ) A b η x) - b =
      ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d) →L[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d)) -
        (2 * η : ℂ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) (A x - b)
proof:
complex_GD_error_identity A b η x

name: cInner
doc:
ℂ ≅ ℝ² 上的实内积（ℝ-双线性，仅对**实**标量齐次，见 `cInner_smul_real_left`；
对 ℂ-标量**不**齐次，故不是 ℂ 上的内积）：`cInner z w = Re(z)·Re(w) + Im(z)·Im(w)`
（等于 `Re(z·conj w)`）。
stmt: def cInner (z w : ℂ) : ℝ
proof: z.re * w.re + z.im * w.im

name: cInner_eq_re_mul_conj
stmt: theorem cInner_eq_re_mul_conj (z w : ℂ) : cInner z w = (z * starRingEnd ℂ w).re
proof:
by
  unfold cInner
  rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  ring

name: cInner_comm
stmt: theorem cInner_comm (z w : ℂ) : cInner z w = cInner w z
proof:
by
  unfold cInner
  ring

name: cInner_self_eq_normSq
doc: 自身内积等于 `normSq`（即模的平方）。
stmt: theorem cInner_self_eq_normSq (z : ℂ) : cInner z z = Complex.normSq z
proof:
by
  unfold cInner
  rw [Complex.normSq_apply]

name: cInner_self_nonneg
stmt: theorem cInner_self_nonneg (z : ℂ) : 0 ≤ cInner z z
proof:
by
  rw [cInner_self_eq_normSq]
  exact Complex.normSq_nonneg z

name: cInner_add_left
stmt:
theorem cInner_add_left (z₁ z₂ w : ℂ) :
    cInner (z₁ + z₂) w = cInner z₁ w + cInner z₂ w
proof:
by
  unfold cInner
  rw [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
  ring

name: cInner_smul_real_left
stmt:
theorem cInner_smul_real_left (r : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    cInner ((r : ℂ) * z) w = r * cInner z w
proof:
by
  unfold cInner
  rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

name: cInner_sq_le
stmt:
theorem cInner_sq_le (z w : ℂ) :
    cInner z w ^ 2 ≤ Complex.normSq z * Complex.normSq w
proof:
by
  unfold cInner
  rw [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.normSq_apply]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z.re * w.im - z.im * w.re)]

name: cInner_le_abs_mul_abs
doc: 由 Cauchy–Schwarz 得到的内积上界（用模的乘积表述）。
stmt:
theorem cInner_le_abs_mul_abs (z w : ℂ) :
    cInner z w ≤ Complex.abs z * Complex.abs w
proof:
by
  have h := cInner_sq_le z w
  have hb : 0 ≤ Complex.abs z * Complex.abs w :=
    mul_nonneg (Complex.abs.nonneg z) (Complex.abs.nonneg w)
  have h2 : cInner z w ^ 2 ≤ (Complex.abs z * Complex.abs w) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Complex.sq_abs, Complex.sq_abs]
    exact h
  exact le_of_sq_le_sq h2 hb

name: cgd
doc: 复数梯度下降一步：`z ↦ z - eta · g z`。
stmt: def cgd (eta : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ
proof: z - (eta : ℂ) * g z

name: cgd_re
stmt:
theorem cgd_re (eta : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    (cgd eta g z).re = z.re - eta * (g z).re
proof:
by
  unfold cgd
  rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

name: cgd_im
stmt:
theorem cgd_im (eta : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    (cgd eta g z).im = z.im - eta * (g z).im
proof:
by
  unfold cgd
  rw [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

name: cgd_zero_grad
stmt: theorem cgd_zero_grad (eta : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : cgd eta (fun _ => 0) z = z
proof:
by
  unfold cgd
  simp

name: cgd_zero_eta
stmt: theorem cgd_zero_eta (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : cgd 0 g z = z
proof:
by
  unfold cgd
  simp

name: scalar_contraction_sq
doc: 一维收缩平方界：`|B| ≤ L|A|`、`eta, L ≥ 0` ⟹ `(A - eta·B)² ≤ (1 + eta·L)²·A²`。
stmt:
theorem scalar_contraction_sq {A B eta L : ℝ} (heta : 0 ≤ eta) (_hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hB : |B| ≤ L * |A|) :
    (A - eta * B) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + eta * L) ^ 2 * A ^ 2
proof:
by
  have h1 : A - eta * B ≤ |A| + eta * |B| := by
    have h2 := neg_le_abs (eta * B)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg heta] at h2
    have h3 := le_abs_self A
    linarith
  have h2 : eta * B - A ≤ |A| + eta * |B| := by
    have h3 := le_abs_self (eta * B)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg heta] at h3
    have h4 := neg_le_abs A
    linarith
  have hc : |A - eta * B| ≤ |A| + eta * |B| := abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hb : |A| + eta * |B| ≤ (1 + eta * L) * |A| := by
    have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB heta
    have h6 : 0 ≤ |A| := abs_nonneg A
    nlinarith [h5, h6]
  have hle : |A - eta * B| ≤ (1 + eta * L) * |A| := le_trans hc hb
  calc (A - eta * B) ^ 2 = |A - eta * B| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ ((1 + eta * L) * |A|) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hle 2
    _ = (1 + eta * L) ^ 2 * |A| ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = (1 + eta * L) ^ 2 * A ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]

name: cgd_contraction_sq
doc:
**复数收缩**：实部与虚部分别 `L`-Lipschitz ⟹ 一步更新的范数平方增长不超过
`(1 + eta·L)²` 倍。
stmt:
theorem cgd_contraction_sq {g : ℂ → ℂ} {eta L : ℝ} (heta : 0 ≤ eta) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hre : ∀ z w : ℂ, |(g z).re - (g w).re| ≤ L * |z.re - w.re|)
    (him : ∀ z w : ℂ, |(g z).im - (g w).im| ≤ L * |z.im - w.im|) (z w : ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq (cgd eta g z - cgd eta g w)
      ≤ (1 + eta * L) ^ 2 * Complex.normSq (z - w)
proof:
by
  have hrediff : (cgd eta g z - cgd eta g w).re
      = (z.re - w.re) - eta * ((g z).re - (g w).re) := by
    rw [Complex.sub_re, cgd_re, cgd_re]
    ring
  have himdiff : (cgd eta g z - cgd eta g w).im
      = (z.im - w.im) - eta * ((g z).im - (g w).im) := by
    rw [Complex.sub_im, cgd_im, cgd_im]
    ring
  have h1 := scalar_contraction_sq (A := z.re - w.re) (B := (g z).re - (g w).re)
    heta hL (hre z w)
  have h2 := scalar_contraction_sq (A := z.im - w.im) (B := (g z).im - (g w).im)
    heta hL (him z w)
  rw [Complex.normSq_apply, hrediff, himdiff, Complex.normSq_apply,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  nlinarith [h1, h2]

end Lattice
